cases.description: Octet is negative; the first condition (octet >= 0) fails, so the method must return false without touching decodeTable.
Octet is non‑negative but greater than or equal to decodeTable.length (the test sets decodeTable length to 64). The second condition fails, so the method returns false.
Octet is within the valid index range (0‑63) and decodeTable[10] is deliberately set to -1. The third condition fails, so the method returns false.
Octet is the lower bound (0) and decodeTable[0] is set to a value other than -1 (e.g., 0). All three conditions are true, so the method returns true.
Octet is the upper bound (decodeTable.length‑1). decodeTable[63] is set to a non‑‑1 value, so the method returns true.
Octet is the upper bound but decodeTable[63] is set to -1 for this case. The final condition fails, yielding false.
Octet is the minimum byte value (-128). The first condition (octet >= 0) fails, so the method must return false regardless of decodeTable.
decodeTable is an empty array (length 0). Although octet is non‑negative, the second condition (octet < decodeTable.length) fails, yielding false.
decodeTable length is 1 and decodeTable[0] is set to -1. All three conditions are evaluated; the third fails, so the method returns false.
decodeTable length is 1 and decodeTable[0] contains a non‑‑1 value (e.g., 42). All conditions are satisfied, resulting in true.
Octet equals decodeTable.length (64). The second condition (octet < decodeTable.length) fails, so the method returns false.
decodeTable length is 100; octet is exactly the length, making the second condition fail and returning false.
decodeTable length is 128 and decodeTable[127] is set to -1. The final condition fails, so false is returned.
decodeTable length is 128 and decodeTable[127] holds a non‑‑1 value (e.g., 1). All conditions succeed, yielding true.
decodeTable length is 100 (smaller than 128). Octet 127 is >= decodeTable.length, so the second condition fails and the method returns false.
decodeTable is null; octet is non‑negative, so evaluation proceeds to decodeTable.length, causing a NullPointerException.
decodeTable is null and octet is within the positive byte range; the method attempts to read decodeTable.length, resulting in a NullPointerException.
